name: Ingestion — Excel Agent Knowledge
description: Manual, UI-only ingestion of the portable Excel Extractor operating guide into PGVector. Compatible with n8n 2.30.8.

nodes.name: Run once to (re)ingest operating guide
nodes.notes: UI-only bootstrap. Configure the PostgreSQL and embedding credentials first, then click Test workflow. Do not activate/publish this workflow. After insert, the Postgres inventory nodes show what is already in the RAG table.

nodes.name: RAG runtime configuration
nodes.notes: UI EDIT: Keep this table name identical to the core workflow node “PGVector operating context”. If the corporate embedding model has different dimensions, choose a NEW table name here and in the core before the first ingest.

nodes.name: RAG documents — portable operating guide
nodes.notes: Exact portable source is also delivered as n8n/rag/excel-agent-operating-guide.documents.json for review and version control. This embedded copy is intentionally used so import/run needs only n8n UI.

nodes.name: Default Data Loader — guide text
nodes.notes: Loads text and durable metadata from each document item. It is a sub-node of the PGVector insertion node.

nodes.name: Recursive Character Text Splitter — 1000/150
nodes.notes: A small static guide is chunked consistently before embedding.

nodes.name: PGVector — insert operating guide
nodes.notes: UI REQUIRED: select the corporate PostgreSQL/pgvector credential. This node auto-creates a fresh table using the connected embedding dimensions. Re-running inserts another copy; use a new table for a clean re-ingest unless IT has an approved cleanup process.

nodes.name: OpenAI Embeddings — REPLACE WITH CORPORATE EMBEDDING
nodes.notes: Placeholder only. In the UI replace this sub-node with the corporate embedding integration/model, then attach the SAME model and embedding dimensions to core → “PGVector operating context”. The 180-second timeout is a conservative ingestion limit; do not run with an unconfigured placeholder.

parameters.jsCode:
const cfg = $('RAG runtime configuration').first().json || {};
const table = typeof cfg.rag_table_name === 'string' ? cfg.rag_table_name.trim() : '';
if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(table)) {
  throw new Error('rag_table_name must be a simple PostgreSQL identifier before inventory SQL can run');
}
const expected = [
  'excel-agent-trust-boundary',
  'excel-agent-discovery-and-tables',
  'excel-agent-query-and-result-protocol',
  'excel-agent-clarification-and-continuation',
  'excel-agent-rag-and-operations',
];
// LEFT JOIN keeps one meta row even when the table is empty, so Summarize always runs.
const query = [
  'WITH inv AS (',
  '  SELECT',
  "    coalesce(metadata->>'document_id', '(missing document_id)') AS document_id",
  "    , coalesce(metadata->>'slug', '') AS slug",
  "    , coalesce(metadata->>'guide_version', metadata->>'version', '') AS guide_version",
  '    , count(*)::int AS chunk_count',
  '    , min(left(text, 120)) AS text_preview',
  `  FROM ${table}`,
  '  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3',
  '), meta AS (',
  `  SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM ${table}) AS total_rows`,
  `       , (SELECT count(DISTINCT nullif(coalesce(metadata->>'document_id', ''), ''))::int FROM ${table}) AS distinct_documents`,
  '       , (',
  '            SELECT pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)',
  '            FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a',
  `            WHERE a.attrelid = to_regclass('${table}')`,
  "              AND a.attname = 'embedding'",
  '              AND NOT a.attisdropped',
  '            LIMIT 1',
  '          ) AS embedding_type',
  ')',
  'SELECT coalesce(inv.document_id, \'(none)\') AS document_id,',
  '       coalesce(inv.slug, \'\') AS slug,',
  '       coalesce(inv.guide_version, \'\') AS guide_version,',
  '       coalesce(inv.chunk_count, 0)::int AS chunk_count,',
  '       inv.text_preview,',
  '       meta.total_rows, meta.distinct_documents, meta.embedding_type',
  'FROM meta',
  'LEFT JOIN inv ON TRUE',
  'ORDER BY 1;',
].join('\n');
return [{ json: {
  rag_table_name: table,
  expected_document_ids: expected,
  expected_document_count: expected.length,
  query,
} }];

nodes.name: Prepare RAG inventory query
nodes.notes: Builds a read-only inventory SQL for the configured table. Safe for UI-only installs: no server shell access required.

nodes.name: Postgres — inspect RAG table contents
nodes.notes: UI REQUIRED: select the SAME PostgreSQL credential as “PGVector — insert operating guide” and as Excel Extractor → “PGVector operating context”. A different credential here silently inspects the wrong database. Output lists document_id, chunk counts, previews, total_rows and embedding_type.

nodes.name: Summarize RAG inventory
nodes.notes: Open this node’s output after Test workflow. status=rag_inventory_ok means all five operating-guide document_id values are present in the configured table.
